relationships.subject: Sema3A
relationships.evidence_quote: sema3A is thought to act as a barrier to endothelial cells survival and migration on vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF)

key_findings: Review: Sema3A via NRP-1/PlexinA may regulate nerve and vessel ingrowth into degenerated IVDs and suppress KLF5-induced inflammation, making it a potential dual-action target for nonspecific low back pain.
